# orbivisor_image (Data Source)

An image catalog entry (built-in or added by an administrator) and the volumes already downloaded from it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Catalog id, e.g. `ubuntu-24.04`.

### Optional

- `arch` (String) `x86_64` or `aarch64` (needed when the id has both).

### Read-Only

- `default_user` (String)
- `firmware` (String)
- `min_size_bytes` (Number)
- `source_format` (String)
- `title` (String)
- `url` (String)
- `volumes` (List of String) Ready volumes downloaded from this image (use one as a clone source).
